---
name: Firewall Recipe Request
about: Request a new reproducible RouterOS firewall recipe
title: "recipe: "
labels: recipe
---

## Target

What service, platform, category, or security goal should the recipe address?

## Intended outcome

What traffic or behavior should be controlled?

## RouterOS version

What RouterOS version(s) have you tested?

## Evidence

List authoritative sources, observed domains, ASNs, CIDRs, or other evidence. Do not paste credentials or private network data.

## IPv4 / IPv6

- [ ] IPv4 tested
- [ ] IPv6 tested

## False-positive risk

Describe shared infrastructure, CDNs, cloud providers, or other collateral impact.

## Rollback

Describe how the generated policy can be safely reversed.
